rationale: MGNI is trading at 90.9% of its intraday range after a 13% gap-up on strong earnings, with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, low-volume consolidation just below the session high — momentum is stalling rather than extending. With 54 minutes to close and no clear directional edge in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify a new position.
